answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Recycling program participation with collection logs is the check: weekly collections logged at one address for years. The price is per head, and the nectar test proves it: A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate collection logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The reef trail is public, the vertex check is cheap to run, and a farm of 192 aliases pays 192 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
